summary: Sporting News previews the Week 4 Thursday Night Football game between the Lions and Packers at Lambeau Field, offering FanDuel single-game GPP lineup picks on a $60,000 budget and SuperDraft multiplier picks. The FanDuel lineup is built around Jared Goff as MVP, with Jordan Love, Romeo Doubs, Sam LaPorta and Luke Musgrave as flex plays, and the piece expects a high-scoring game given the injuries on both sides. SuperDraft picks lean on Amon-Ra St. Brown as Champion plus Goff, Jahmyr Gibbs, Love and Aaron Jones.
one_line: Nick Brinkerhoff's FanDuel and SuperDraft DFS picks for the Week 4 Lions-Packers Thursday night game, led by Jared Goff as MVP.
key_facts: FanDuel Lions-Packers TNF single-game contests use a $60,000 budget, with four-point passing TDs and half-point PPR scoring.
The MVP pick (1.5x points) is Lions QB Jared Goff at $15,500, who may face a Packers defense without star corner Jaire Alexander (back).

Packers allow 207.3 passing yards per game (No. 18), though Pro Football Focus grades them No. 8 in coverage with an 81.5; their first three opponents ranked No. 15, 29 and 31 in passing yards per game.

FLEX QB Jordan Love ($16,000) has seven passing touchdowns through three weeks and faces a bottom-10 passing defense per PFF, with Detroit's secondary just starting life without C.J. Gardner-Johnson (pec).
FLEX WR Romeo Doubs ($10,500) is tied for the Packers' team lead in targets and leads with three touchdowns; he and Jayden Reed have combined for 12-of-16 red-zone targets to receivers.
Christian Watson appears primed to return from a hamstring injury but the article doubts his workload, so it favors Doubs.
FLEX TE Sam LaPorta ($10,000), a Lions rookie, had 5, 6 and 11 targets in Weeks 1-3 for 39, 63 and 84 yards, scoring a touchdown in Week 3.

FLEX TE Luke Musgrave ($8,000) is coming off six catches for 49 yards and faces the second-worst defense against tight ends; FantasyPros says the Lions give up 14.8 fantasy points per game to the position.

SuperDraft uses point multipliers instead of salary caps; scoring includes half-point PPR, four-point passing TDs and two-point bonuses for 100 rushing yards, 100 receiving yards and 300 passing yards.
SuperDraft Champion (+50%) is Amon-Ra St. Brown (1.5x); Super FLEX picks are Goff (1.1x), Jahmyr Gibbs (1.2x), Love (1.15x) and Aaron Jones (1.1x).
Aaron Jones is a must-have if healthy given AJ Dillon's clunkers over the last two weeks; otherwise the article suggests pivoting to a pass-catcher.
The Lions swept the Packers last season and ended the Aaron Rodgers era in Green Bay; Jordan Love is now the Packers' quarterback.
